name: onboarding-drip
description: Welcome email, day-1 getting-started email, then a business-day activation check that nudges inactive users and alerts the success team.
author: orch8-io
requires: An HTTP email API reachable at context.data.email_api_url that accepts {template, to}.
An activation-status endpoint at context.data.activation_status_url returning JSON {"activated": bool}.
An event trigger whose slug is context.data.success_team_trigger (emit_event fails if the trigger does not exist).
